extracted.name: Oven-Roasted Cabbage
extracted.description: This roasted cabbage recipe with bacon and onions gets added flavor from butter, broth, and a pinch of seasoned salt for a deliciously savory side.
ingredient_lines: 1 pinch seasoned salt (such as LAWRY'S®), or to taste
salt and ground black pepper to taste
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Stir cabbage, chicken broth, onion, butter, bacon, seasoned salt, salt, and black pepper together in a 9x13-inch baking dish. Cover the dish with aluminum foil.
Bake in the preheated oven until cabbage is tender, 1 ½ to 2 hours.
